BL-1915 — A landed ticket's own register rows (standing reds, suite poles, property allowlist) leave main in the commit that closes it, so a line whose ticket owns a row lands on the merge path instead of being rebuilt by the land step
What it solves: ## Why
Approval context: The first slice BL-1870 names before the land step's rebuild machinery can be deleted. FIRM - which rows leave (the closing ticket's own, never an accepted pole, never another open ticket's) is BL-1631's rule, reused, not rewritten; the land step keeps retiring at land until the deletion slice, and…
